popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Apollodorus places Oecles in the Melampodid line as father of Amphiaraus — the seer-house that marches on Thebes and ends in earth-swallowing prophecy.

popCulture.title: Oicles
popCulture.description: Son of Antiphates, husband of Hypermnestra, father of Amphiaraus — Melampus' descendant who fights with Heracles at Troy in some accounts and founds the Amphiaraid house.

popCulture.title: Amphiaraus
popCulture.description: Oecles' son — the reluctant prophet bribed into the Theban war, swallowed by the earth, worshipped as oracle-hero at Oropos.

popCulture.title: Seven Against Thebes
popCulture.creator: Aeschylus
popCulture.description: Aeschylus' war keeps Amphiaraus as Oecles' heir at the seventh gate — the Melampodid foresight that cannot refuse Eriphyle's necklace.
